notes: The app has no destinations or spots in this region, so there is nothing to move (existing_fixes empty). Six destinations are proposed, none added.

Parks with fewer than three kept spots are spots or standalone, per the brief: Wollumbin NP (spot of Tweed Heads) and Nightcap NP (spot of Lismore, with Minyon Falls and Nimbin) lie inside a proposed span; Border Ranges NP and Yuraygir NP are standalone. Deferred park-destination proposals: Nightcap NP (Minyon Falls, Nimbin plus review Protesters Falls, Killen Falls), Yuraygir NP (Yuraygir Coastal Walk, Angourie plus review Brooms Head, Wooli), Wollumbin NP (no sibling spots). If approved, move those spots and keep their ids.
Arakwal National Park sits 1.7 km from Byron Bay and is a Byron Bay spot (a park destination would overlap the town); owner may prefer otherwise.
Mount Warning is folded into the Wollumbin National Park bio (Mount Warning rejected as the same place).

Seven Mile Beach shares a name with a Shoalhaven beach: its photo needs an explicit WIKI_IMAGE_OVERRIDES entry. Every accepted photo here should be registered as an override keyed by photo_override_key (many places have no Wikipedia article).

Ticket URLs verified by scripts/curation/fetch.ts (title names the place): NPWS pages for Cape Byron Lighthouse, Cape Byron Walk, Arakwal, Broken Head, Wollumbin, Nightcap, Minyon Falls lookout, Yuraygir walk and park, Iluka Nature Reserve, Border Ranges; crystalcastle.com.au; gallery.tweed.nsw.gov.au; lismoregallery.org; northernriversrailtrail.com.au. Left out: beaches, villages, towns, Julian Rocks (many operators), Tallow Beach, Bundjalung (no spot), Big Prawn, lighthouses at Point Danger/Yamba (no steward page checked).

Hours and costs: only sourced values used (NPWS hours, Crystal Castle, Lismore gallery). Costs omitted unless free; paid entries (Crystal Castle, Tweed Regional Gallery) and park/parking fees are not sourced as entry prices. Tweed Regional Gallery hours not found in the fetched pages.

Coordinates: several are Wikivoyage/Wikipedia centroids (Border Ranges, Yuraygir, Nightcap, Mullumbimby 28.55/153.5 rounded, Murwillumbah rounded, Lennox Head rounded, Evans Head rounded): run scripts/audit-spot-coordinates.ts after adding.
